snippet.title: Mortal Sin - Official 1.0 Launch Trailer
snippet.description:
The time has finally come! Get the definitive version of Mortal Sin on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/1494810/Mortal_Sin/

Discord: https://discord.com/invite/aHHjvWHKzg
Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/mortalsingame
Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/MortalSinGame/
TikTok: https://www.tiktok.com/@mortalsingame
X: https://x.com/MortalSinGame
Bluesky: https://bsky.app/profile/mortalsingame.bsky.social
Threads: https://www.threads.com/@mortalsingame
Website: https://www.mortalsingame.com/

Mortal Sin is built around fast, visceral melee combat where every strike matters. Chain slashes, bashes, and kicks into devastating finishers as limbs fly and blood paints the walls. Combat thrives on momentum: move fast, hit hard, and never give your enemies a chance to breathe.
